header: Option 1: Approve enterprise application permissions by user request
content:
Once this setting is verified, users can go through the enterprise customer sign-in at Microsoft
security intelligence
, and submit a request for admin consent, including justification.
Administrators can review and approve the application permissions Azure admin consent
requests
.
After providing consent, all users in the tenant will be able to use the application.
This process requires that Global Administrators go through the Enterprise customer sign-in
flow at Microsoft security intelligence
.
